capture.zh: SPT面板选择螺旋星系→普兰特，在米娜村落挑战，打败获得精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 雷伊（极光刃/雷神天明闪/雷神觉醒）先消掉攻击强化，黑电斯加尔卡自杀，魔焰猩猩两次觉醒后大招带过；火、圣灵、飞行（冰、暗影）系克制；小心睡眠。

engine_notes: immune_pct_damage: 海洋之心 and other 'lose X% of current/max HP' (大比例扣血) skills deal no damage / miss against this boss (ops pct_damage, and 同生共死-style HP-equalising scripts).
immune_stage_down: 属性消弱吸能无效.
Innate 攻击等级+2 (sic; the 4399 text says attack even though the species is a special attacker) — boost can be cleared (雷伊消强).
暴击率很高 — crit_rate_up; 偶尔使用技能还会先手 — random_priority (chance estimated).
Boss version of 混沌绿光 puts the player to sleep at least 50% of the time (learnset version: 10%); 蚀梦术 is said to crit 25% vs sleeping targets.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
source_note: 4399 SPT page 2012-05-19: 8000血量, 天生攻击+2, 暴击率很高, 海洋之心无效.
